capabilities: Create people and company notes from Gmail metadata
Track contact activity and relationship scores
List contacts worth reconnecting with in a CRM table
Open personal and shared people graphs in a tab
Enrich people notes with Anthropic using an own API key
disambiguation: Not a geographic mapping tool; the atlas is a graph of people and their relationships.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. Credentials, API keys and contact indexes are stored unencrypted in plugin data; the hosted graph, score push and AI enrichment are optional and send data off-device. Setup, scoring and troubleshooting are documented in a separate plugin guide.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn email activity into a maintained contact database, so relationship history and reconnect reminders must be tracked by hand.

relations.evidence: Gmail sync requires a Google account and Google OAuth authorization.
Optionally enrich people notes with Anthropic using your own API key.
The optional hosted People graph requires a separate People sign-in and internet access
BRAT remains an optional beta installation method.
The separately installed PeopleGraph CLI is optional.

summary: Personal CRM that creates people and company notes from Gmail metadata and shows personal and shared relationship graphs in a tab.
